([[Girabola|Girabola 2nd place]]) | continentalcup3 = | continentalcup3 qualifiers = | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | matches = 210 | total goals = | prevseason = [[1996 Girabola|1996]] | nextseason = [[1998 Girabola|1998]] }} The '''1996 [[Girabola]]''' was the 19th season of top-tier football competition in [[Angola]]. [[C.D. Primeiro de Agosto|Primeiro de Agosto]] were the defending champions. The league comprised 14 teams, the bottom two of which were relegated. [[Atlético Petróleos de Luanda|Petro de Luanda]] were crowned champions, winning their 11th title, while [[S.H. Benfica (Huambo)|Benfica do Huambo]] and [[Estrela Clube Primeiro de Maio|Primeiro de Maio]] were relegated. ''Zé Neli'' of [[Atlético Petróleos do Huambo|Petro do Huambo]] finished as the top scorer with 12 goals. ==Changes from the 1996 season== '''Relegated:''' [[Clube Nacional de Benguela|Nacional de Benguela]]
